purpose: enforce code quality, style and correctness rules automatically on every change so reviewers can spend time on design
entry_criteria: Linter, formatter and type checker are chosen
Rules are agreed by the team
procedure: Configure the formatter, linter and type checker in the repository with pinned versions.
Start with a rule set the team agrees on; record a baseline for existing violations so only new ones block.
Run the tools locally, in a pre-commit hook and in CI as a required check.
Fix new violations; allow a suppression only with a comment explaining why and a link to an issue.
Track the number of suppressions and the baseline over time and reduce them.
Review the rule set when the team finds a rule unhelpful, and change it by decision, not by silent suppression.
acceptance_criteria: Suppressions have explanations and issue links

validation.command: ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy .   # example for Python

validation.expect: count does not grow without justification

failure_modes.detection: Config edited to relax rules in the same change

failure_modes.response: Add reason and issue or remove

failure_modes.detection: Different results locally and in CI

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A pre-commit hook and a required CI check run the formatter, linter and type checker. A new unused-variable warning blocks a pull request until fixed; suppressions are limited to three, each with an issue link.
